messages.subject: Cannot run apps in rstudio - new install
parts:
Installed latest R 3.2, 

> sessionInfo()
R version 3.2.0 (2015-04-16)
Platform: i386-w64-mingw32/i386 (32-bit)
Running under: Windows 7 (build 7601) Service Pack 1

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252 
[2] LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252   
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252

[5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252    

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
[1] shiny_0.12.0

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] R6_2.0.1         htmltools_0.2.6  tools_3.2.0      rstudioapi_0.3.1
[5] Rcpp_0.11.6      digest_0.6.8     xtable_1.7-4     httpuv_1.3.2    
[9] mime_0.3 

when I load the shiny library and runApp  I get the following error:

> runApp(launch.browser=FALSE)

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:7169
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'jsonlite', details:
  call: loadNamespace(name)
  error: there is no package called ‘rstudio’


In fact, there is no package called rstudio and why is it being called?
